description:
Ray's Workshop is where home repair gets explained the old way — slowly, plainly, and with real numbers. Every video takes one common household problem and walks it through start to finish: what the part is, what it actually costs, how to test it so you know for certain, and how to fix it without breaking anything. Furnaces, water heaters, plumbing, appliances, drafts — the stuff that keeps a house running and quietly drains your wallet when it doesn't.

No shouting, no fifteen-second cuts, no "smash that like button." Just a workbench, a problem, and the way a tradesman would explain it to his neighbor.

Ray is the illustrated host of this channel. The methods are real — drawn from trade practice, manufacturer service manuals, and testing. Every price and part number is checked before it goes in a video.
